*   `?g A4`: Main Concept is A4 (Fauna / Animal).
    *   `+ White`: A cube of White color is on A4.
    *   `+ E1`: A cube of E1 (Cold / Snow – Rain / Cloud) is on A4.
    *   `+ G10`: A cube of G10 (Big / High) is on A4.

    *   Main concept: Animal.
    *   Attribute 1: White.
    *   Attribute 2: Cold / Snow / Rain / Cloud.
    *   Attribute 3: Big / High.

    *   Polar Bear (White, cold/snow, big).
    *   Whale (White is less common but possible, cold/water, big - wait, E1 is specifically cold/snow/rain/cloud, whales are water/sea, E1 is more terrestrial/atmospheric cold).
    *   Arctic Fox (White, cold, but is it "Big"? Compared to a mouse, yes, but usually "Big" implies something larger).
    *   Mammoth (White/grey, cold, big).
    *   Walrus (White-ish/grey, cold, big).
    *   Snow Leopard (White/grey, cold, but medium-sized).

    *   Polar Bear fits "White", "Cold/Snow", and "Big" perfectly.

    *   Polar bear
    *   Arctic fox
    *   Walrus
